You are doing an INDEPENDENT final visual review of a high-fidelity webpage reproduction. Do NOT edit files — produce a findings report only.

TARGET (original site): https://stateofaidesign.com/ — "AI in Design Report 2026" by Designer Fund.
REPRODUCTION: /Users/carlo/dev/fronted_reproduce_aiindesign/opus48-high-2026-07-17/index.html (open via file://)

Evidence available:
- Original scene screenshots: /Users/carlo/dev/fronted_reproduce_aiindesign/evidence/orig_*.jpeg (orig_top, orig_1150, orig_1800, orig_3600, orig_4300, orig_5200, orig_6200, orig_7000, orig_7600, orig_9200, orig_bottom, orig_cards2)
- Reproduction screenshots: /Users/carlo/dev/fronted_reproduce_aiindesign/opus48-high-2026-07-17/shots_repro/r_*.jpeg
- Scene evidence table: /Users/carlo/dev/fronted_reproduce_aiindesign/opus48-high-2026-07-17/SCENE_EVIDENCE.md
- Self diff list: /Users/carlo/dev/fronted_reproduce_aiindesign/opus48-high-2026-07-17/DIFF_LIST.md

Your job:
1. Read the evidence table and diff list.
2. Compare original vs reproduction screenshots scene-by-scene (Read the image files directly).
3. Optionally use chrome-devtools MCP to open the reproduction file:// URL and scroll (note: page 2 in the browser is the live original, page 3 is the reproduction — do not disturb them if busy; you may open a new page).
4. Assess: color palette accuracy (orange #FE7141, lavender #CDABFE, sage #D1DDD3), typography (Beausite Classic display / Geist Mono / Inter), scene narrative beats, subject proportions, chapter accent-color transitions, case-study carousel, finale giant type, cinematic layering.
5. Report a prioritized list of visual discrepancies: each with scene#, original vs reproduction, severity (High/Medium/Low), and concrete fix. Where a discrepancy conflicts with pixel evidence, note it.

Keep it focused and evidence-based. Return the findings list as your final message.
